prompt: A vertical snapshot on grainy colour film, from the customer's side of a British corner shop counter late at night. On the scuffed counter: a loaf of plain white sliced bread, a small handwritten card propped against it reading "50p", a few copper and silver coins, and a small unbranded purple chocolate bar. Behind the counter nobody, just an empty stool still turning slightly, a pulled-down metal shutter, a newspaper rack with unreadable headlines, a UK three-pin plug socket with a kettle lead. Fluorescent tubes blow out at the top of frame, cold teal cast, dark corners, soft focus. Unstaged, ordinary, and wrong. Thanks.
